================================================================================
to/in/from/step as identifiers (Ring's keyword demotion: these keywords are
always demoted at identifier positions — ring_parser_processkeywords)
================================================================================

from = 1
to = 10
step = 2
? from
? to
? step
x = from + to * step

================================================================================
demoted keywords as object attributes (oop160 class-body pattern)
================================================================================

class MyTest
    From = 100
    To = 110

new MyTest { test() }

func use o
    ? o.from
    o.to = 5
    o.step()

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
keywords stay keywords in their construct positions (regression: the demotion
must not raid `for`, `foreach`, or `class ... from`)
================================================================================

for i = 1 to 10 step 2
    ? i
next

for x in aList
    ? x
next

class B from A

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
